name: run-lot-pane
description: Side pane following a run-lot run, or a run-plan run with a plan view and navigation between its batches: phases as columns, agents (model, duration, tokens per agent, slowness, stalls, retries, interruptions), estimated end, batch sheet, audit verdict and rounds, run outcome with the knowledge-base merge a plan staged, end toast; steers the run: entries to validate, notes, dependency graph
